ruleset.name: SilverAssist
ruleset.description: Framework-agnostic base ruleset for Silver Assist PHP projects: PSR-12 plus mandatory PHPDoc on classes and methods. No WordPress sniffs live here — see silverassist/wp-coding-standards (SilverAssistWP) for the WordPress-plugin overlay. Consumers reference this as `<rule ref="SilverAssist"/>` from their own phpcs.xml, which also declares its own <file> scan paths (deliberately not set here, since those are project-specific).
